To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(i) The ubiquitin ligase KLHL12 regulates COPII coat assembly by monoubiquitylating SEC31.
CUL3–Klhl12 catalyses the ubiquitylation of the coat component Sec31, thereby controlling COPII coat assembly, and that this process is essential for the export of large cargo.
CUL3–Klhl12 controls COPII coat assembly, coat size, and function by monoubiquitylating SEC31, and thereby regulates the transport of large cargo.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the regulation of the size and function COPII vesicle coats.
the regulation of the endoplasmatic reticulum (ER) export machinery and how defects in this machinery lead to human diseases.
the molecular mechanisms underlying the assembly of COPII coats and the regulation of their size.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the CUL3–Klhl12 E3 ubiquitin ligase regulates the formation and function of COPII coats by catalysing the monoubiquitin modification of Sec31.
CUL3–klhl12 controls the size of COPII coats, and thereby the size of the vesicles that are formed.
CUL3–KHL12 is required for the formation of larger COPII vesicular structures, which in turn is required for the secretion of larger cargo such as chylomicrons and procollagen fibils.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the CUL3–KHLH12 E3 ubiquitin ligase regulates the size of COPII coats and thereby affects cargo selection and transport.
the ubiquitin system regulates COPII vesicle size and cargo selection.
ubiquitylation of a vesicle component by a ubiquitin ligase controls the formation of a vesicle.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the ubiquitylation machinery can control vesicle formation.
ubiquitylation of a COPII coat protein controls coat size and function, and that this is essential to export large cargo.
the monoubiquitin ligase Cullin3–Klhl12 regulates the size of COPII coats by controlling the assembly of the COPIIC component Sec31.
